CustomField.description: Which campaign tier this template creates. Rollup = top-level organizing anchor (year or program). Strategy = mid-tier coordinated set of asks. Ask = individual solicitation. The setup flow and Apex builder use this field to place the created Campaign at the right position in the three-level hierarchy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Rollup creates a top-level Campaign (year rollup or evergreen program top). Strategy creates a mid-tier Campaign. Ask creates a leaf-level Campaign linked to a strategy.
CustomField.label: Level
